name: voices-ai
description: Turn text into natural speech, change, clean up and transcribe the voice in recordings, and create songs with Voices AI.

interface.longDescription:
Voices AI brings its voice library into the chat. Ask for a voice by name, style or language, then have it read any text and play the result right in the chat, or download the MP3. Change the voice in your own audio or video recordings while the words, timing and emotion stay the same. Create complete songs from a short description, with vocals and a cover image.

It also works on recordings you already have. Transcribe an interview, meeting or video into text with timestamps or subtitles, then have the assistant summarize or quote it. Remove background noise, music and echo so only the voice remains.

You sign in with your Voices AI account, and everything uses the credits on that account. Your own cloned voices from the Voices AI app are available too, and only to you. Everything you create also appears in your Voices AI history.
defaultPrompt: Read this paragraph aloud with a calm narrator voice and give me the MP3.
Transcribe my recording and summarize the key points.
Remove the background noise from my recording.

positive.description: Text to speech with a chosen voice
positive.prompt: Use Voices AI to read this with the voice Emily: Welcome to our weekly podcast, today we talk about sleep.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Emily, generates the speech and shows it in the Voices AI audio player, with a link to the MP3.

positive.description: Change the voice in a recording from a link
positive.prompt: Change the voice in https://cdn.getvoices.ai/voice_example/en/voice_adam.mp3 to a female voice that works with the voice changer.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a voice with voice_changer: true, converts the recording and shows the new audio in the audio player, or returns an id that get_generation later resolves to the audio.

positive.description: Transcribe a recording and summarize it
positive.prompt: Transcribe https://cdn.getvoices.ai/voice_example/en/voice_emily.mp3 with Voices AI and summarize it in one sentence.
positive.expected_behavior: Transcribes the recording, returns the transcript with timestamps, and the assistant summarizes it. A longer recording returns an id that get_transcription resolves.

positive.description: Remove background noise from a recording
positive.prompt: Clean up the voice in https://cdn.getvoices.ai/voice_example/en/voice_adam.mp3 with Voices AI so only the voice remains.
positive.expected_behavior: Isolates the voice and shows the cleaned audio in the audio player, or returns an id that get_generation later resolves to the audio.

positive.prompt: Create a short upbeat pop song about a sunny weekend with Voices AI.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the song, then checks it with get_song and shows it with its cover in the audio player once it is complete.

negative.prompt: Use Voices AI to make Taylor Swift say happy birthday to my friend.
What will the weather be like in Paris tomorrow?
Delete everything in my Voices AI history.
